CustomField.description: Validation rule prevents user from saving a value which has special characters (*&?%). 50 character limit. Drive Keyword on the Blood Drive Opportunity object inherits value.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Keywords are: maximum 50 characters; part of the URL link; used to search for drives on RCB.org.; not required to be unique; not case sensitive; not numbers; not ‘and’, ‘or’, ‘left’, ‘right’ as standalone words; not special characters (, ), *, ?, %,!, ‘,”
CustomField.label: Sponsor Keyword
